maria: Follow-up from the postmortem: repeated cascade pattern -> cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> short user errors. We need a single remediation tracker, named owners, and a monthly cadence. Who can take point? :mag:
aj: I can own the tracker and rotation. I'll create a simple sheet (owner, status, priority, SLA mapping). Can someone export the last 90 days of vendor-tagged incidents for me? :file_folder:
liam: I'll pull alerts/logs and create a vendor-week heatmap with deploy markers and time-of-day spikes. ETA: EOD today.
sre_lead: Also audit our circuit-breaker thresholds and autoscaler backoff; retries might be amplifying failures. Add "failure_mode" and "short_term_mitigation" columns to the tracker.
kate: I'll reconcile runbooks with observed behaviors and propose quick patches for token jitter handling and cross-region retry. Draft by Tue AM.
security: I'll review KMS/key rotation windows and token TTLs. If rotations are synchronized, propose adding jitter/stagger. Report Monday.
oncall-bot: Linked INC-2026-0413-07; creating tracker item DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned to AJ.
aj: Action list (please react with :white_check_mark:):
- AJ: remediation tracker (sheet + owners)
